title: IELTS Exam Overall Score by First Language
text:
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
performance_by_first_language <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-08-18/performance_by_first_language.csv')
view(performance_by_first_language)


overall <- performance_by_first_language |> 
    filter(part == "overall") |> 
    group_by(language)

title: Squirrels in Central Park
text:
Code
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
squirrel_data <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2023/2023-05-23/squirrel_data.csv')
view(squirrel_data)




Code
squirrel_data <- squirrel_data |> 
  filter(Age %in% c("Adult", "Juvenile"))




Code
ggplot(squirrel_data, aes(x = X, y = Y, color = Age))+
  geom_point(
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.3)+
  labs(
    x = "Longtitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    title = "Adults and Juvenile Squirrels Sighted in Central Park")

title: Spotify Songs
text:
Code
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
spotify_songs <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2020/2020-01-21/spotify_songs.csv')
view(spotify_songs)




Code
ggplot(spotify_songs, aes(x = playlist_genre, y = track_popularity))+
    geom_boxplot()+
    labs(x = "Playlist genre",
    y = "Popularity",
    title = "Popularity by playlist genre")
